frozen_criteria_restatement: Threshold is strictly greater than $500M FDV at 4:00 PM ET on the calendar day after token launch; launch requires actively, publicly transferable and tradable token. No launch by Dec. 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET resolves No. Resolution source: most liquid available price source.

primary_findings.source: Kraken blog, “Announcing Ink: The new DeFi destination”
primary_findings.facts: Identifies Ink as Kraken-released Optimism Superchain L2; this article discusses the network, not token supply or launch.

primary_findings.source: Kraken blog, “Ink fast-tracks Layer 2 mainnet launch, driving DeFi development boom”
primary_findings.facts: Reports Ink L2 mainnet live; user instructions identify ETH as gas token. Network launch does not establish launch of separate $INK asset.

primary_findings.source: Kraken blog, “Coming soon: Integrating $INK Token and Ink Layer 2 protocols into our core products”
primary_findings.facts: Plans to integrate $INK/Ink L2; token to be issued by Ink Foundation subsidiary, with planned Kraken Drops/airdrop to eligible active clients and ecosystem participants. Further details deferred. No date, supply, contract, trading venue, or FDV stated.

primary_findings.source: Kraken official Ink category archive, current captured listing
primary_findings.facts: Listing shows Ink Points loyalty program dated Apr. 13, 2026 and $INK plan dated Jul. 24, 2025; it does not establish token launch.

identity_distinctions: Ink L2 is the network; its 2024 mainnet article says gas token is ETH.
July 2025 $INK is a distinct planned asset; issuance assigned to Ink Foundation subsidiary.
April 2026 Ink Points is called a loyalty program; no captured source equates it to issued/transferable $INK.
Avoid conflating unrelated projects/assets sharing “Ink” or “INK”; this supplement only concerns Kraken’s Ink L2 and the token described by Kraken’s July 2025 announcement.
gaps: These sources do not state $INK supply/tokenomics, contract, launch date, transferability, spot listing, or FDV.
Bounded pages only; gaps do not establish global absence.
